templates.label: Survival Mode
templates.description: Protect the streak. Don't break momentum.

tasks.action: Listen to 1 Divine Intervention episode passively

rules: If even 15 minutes is impossible, that's okay. Rest counts.
Do NOT open UWorld — you'll feel bad about not finishing a block.

templates.label: Minimum Viable Day
templates.description: One small win. Keep the chain alive.

tasks.action: Review weak topic in FA (10 pages max)

rules: Quality over quantity. 20 reviewed questions > 40 rushed ones.
Pick the system you're weakest in for the UWorld block.
Skip videos today — they need sustained attention you don't have.

templates.label: Standard Training
templates.description: This is the bread and butter. Most of your progress happens here.

tasks.action: Anki reviews + new cards (50-80 new max)
UWorld block 1 (40 Qs, system-based or mixed)
FA review of today's weak system OR 1 video lecture

rules: UWorld is the main event. Everything else supports it.
If behind on Anki reviews (>300 pending), skip new cards and clear reviews first.
Alternate between system-based and random blocks based on prep phase.

templates.label: Attack Day
templates.description: Push hard. This is where scores move.

tasks.action: Review all incorrects from both blocks
Video lecture OR FA pass on weak system
Sketchy video if in micro/pharm phase

rules: 80 questions is the target today. Don't exceed 100 — diminishing returns.
Take a 10-minute break between blocks. Walk, stretch, hydrate.
If this is a weekend, consider doing an NBME instead of two UWorld blocks.

templates.label: Full Send
templates.description: Maximum output. Usually weekends or days off.

tasks.action: Video lectures (2-3 lectures on weak system)
Sketchy video + Anki new cards for that topic
UWorld block 3 if energy permits (40 Qs)

rules: 100-120 questions is the ceiling. Beyond that, retention drops.
Take REAL breaks — not phone-scrolling breaks.
If it's NBME week, replace UWorld blocks 1-2 with a full NBME + 3-hour review.
Stop by 10pm regardless. Sleep is non-negotiable.

content_phase.emphasis: Video lectures + FA + system-based UWorld (tutor mode)
content_phase.ankiStrategy: Add new cards from Sketchy + current system

training_phase.emphasis: UWorld volume + transition to random timed blocks
training_phase.ankiStrategy: Focus on UWorld incorrect cards, reduce new adds

assessment_phase.emphasis: NBMEs weekly + UWorld incorrects + targeted remediation
assessment_phase.ankiStrategy: Reviews only in final 2 weeks, no new cards

final_week.ankiStrategy: Mature card reviews only. Suspend low-yield tags.
